item.title: Republic Day Parade to celebrate Vande Mataram’s 150 years, enclosures named after Indian rivers
item.description: NEW DELHI: The sesquicentenary of ‘Vande Mataram’ will be the dominant theme of this year’s Republic Day Parade, with enclosure backdrops along the Kartavya Path displaying old paintings illustrating the opening stanzas of the National Song and floral artworks at the main stage paying homage to its composer Bankim Chandra Chatterjee. item.title: “His contribution to Tamil Nadu’s progress is outstanding”: PM Modi pays tribute to AIADMK’s founder MGR
item.description: NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday paid tribute to the legendary actor and politician MG Ramachandran on his birth anniversary. item.title: Ganga aarti a cultural, civilisational heritage: Uttarakhand High Court on allowing to continue ritual
item.description: NAINITAL: In the ongoing dispute regarding the future of the Ganga aarti held at the Triveni Ghat in Rishikesh, the Uttarakhand High Court permitted the Shri Ganga Sabha to continue performing the ritual, subject to certain conditions. The vacation bench of Justice Ashish Nainthani delivered this decision, keeping public interest and religious sentiments in mind. [...]
